full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white architectural photograph looks up a monumental pale stone courtyard formed by broad stairs, high blocklike walls and deep arches. The steps begin across the lower middle and climb toward a smaller opening in the distant upper-left center. Two tiny people stand together on the first rise, and a few more distant figures appear near the far landing, making the surrounding volumes feel immense. On the right, a massive pale wall slopes inward and contains a tall dark arch close to the camera; a smaller arch repeats beside it. Across the center, a blocklike facade carries another large semicircular opening, with a few small square apertures higher up. A long wall on the left closes the courtyard and narrows the view toward the far passage. The pale stone is built from subtly striped courses, visible even where sunlight nearly washes it white. Strong daylight falls from above and left, cutting a triangular shadow across the central wall and casting darker bands over the steps. The arch interiors fall almost black, creating deep recesses against the luminous stone. The sky is a simple light gray wedge between the high forms. Straight edges, repeated curves and long stair lines create an exacting rhythm, while the tiny human silhouettes provide scale without becoming the subject. No signs or readable text are visible. The overall composition is austere and expansive, using a narrow grayscale range, hard light and geometric depth to make the courtyard feel both open and enclosed.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形黑白建筑照片向上望入纪念性浅石庭院，宽台阶、高大块状墙体与深拱洞围成空间。台阶从下部中央横向铺开，向左上中央远处一道较小开口攀升。两名小人站在第一段上升处，更远处平台附近还有几名极小人物，让周围体量显得巨大。右侧，一面庞大浅色墙向内倾斜，近处开有一座高大暗拱；旁边又重复一座较小拱洞。中央的块状立面有另一道大型半圆开口，上方散布几个小方窗。左边长墙封住庭院，把视线收束到远处通道。浅石表面由细微条状砌层组成，即使在日光几乎将其洗白之处也仍可见。强日光从左上照下，在中央墙面切出三角形阴影，在台阶上投下更深的横带。拱洞内部近乎黑色，与发亮石面形成深凹对比。天空只是高大形体之间一块简单浅灰楔形。直边、重复曲线与长台阶线建立严整节奏，极小人物剪影提供尺度，却不成为主题。看不到标识或可读文字。整体构图严峻而开阔，以狭窄灰阶、硬光与几何纵深让庭院同时显得敞开与围合。
style_prompt_en: A restrained monochrome photographic treatment arranges enormous pale geometric planes against deep nearly black recesses. Fine horizontal surface grain remains visible within the broad light areas, preventing the tonal structure from becoming entirely abstract. Straight rising lines and repeated semicircular voids establish a strong perspective rhythm. Hard directional daylight cuts large triangular shadows and alternating bright bands, while the darkest interiors keep their detail minimal. Small scale markers emphasize the size of surrounding forms without disrupting the clean composition. The palette is limited to white, silver gray, charcoal and black; spatial depth comes from overlap, steep convergence and abrupt value changes. The overall effect is monumental, quiet and rigorously ordered.
style_prompt_zh: 克制的黑白摄影处理把巨大的浅色几何平面排列在近黑凹处前。宽阔亮区内部仍有细微横向表面纹理，不让明暗结构完全抽象化。笔直上升线与重复半圆形空隙建立强烈透视节奏。硬定向日光切出大型三角影与明暗交替的色带，最深内层则保留极少细节。小尺度参照强调周围形体的大小，却不扰乱干净构图。色盘限于白、银灰、炭灰与黑；空间纵深来自重叠、陡峭汇聚和骤然明度变化。整体宏大、安静而秩序严谨。
theme_en: A monumental pale stone courtyard of arches and broad ascending steps
theme_zh: 由拱洞与宽阔上行台阶构成的浅石色纪念性庭院
name: Rafael Moneo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
